overview.label: Overview
overview.description: Library entry point that introduces the catalog and links to every area.

guide.label: Getting started guide
guide.description: Installation and integration guide, including the shared Astro integration target.

tokens.label: Design tokens
tokens.description: Semantic token reference for colour, type, spacing, radius and motion.

ux-standards.label: UX standards
ux-standards.description: Normative measurement, surface and state, motion and focus, layer and overlay rules.

genux.label: GenUX
genux.description: GenUX contract, policy and registration status reference.

color-lab.label: Color lab
color-lab.description: Interactive colour system and contrast exploration.

standard.label: Documentation standard
standard.description: Published page types, section order, rules, source map, admission workflow and verification limits.

adaptive-lab.label: Adaptive lab
adaptive-lab.description: Capability-first adaptive layout and input lab, with integration guidance and stated verification limits.

redirect.label: Legacy redirect
redirect.description: Retired route that only redirects to its declared canonical target. Legacy fragments are mapped by docs/src/data/token-redirects.ts.

component.label: Component
component.description: Any generated route of the form /components/<slug>/ is a component page and must pass the full common contract.

previewDocuments.label: Isolated example preview
previewDocuments.description: Prerendered document for one literal ExamplePreview id and one profile. It is not a documentation page and is checked by the preview rules only.

verification: The gate inspects generated HTML structure only. It is not browser, computed-style, visual, device or CI evidence.

rules.event: A generated HTML page is inspected after the Astro build.
rules.condition: The route is neither a listed foundation route nor a single-segment component route under /components/.
rules.action: Fail the build; add the route to a known page kind or remove it.

rules.event: A generated HTML page is inspected after the Astro build.
rules.condition: The page does not contain exactly one h1.
rules.action: Fail the build; keep a single page title.

rules.condition: The section has no non-empty accessible heading name.
rules.action: Fail the build; give the section a visible heading.

rules.condition: Two sections on the page share the same name.
rules.action: Fail the build; give every section an unambiguous name.

rules.condition: The section id is used by more than one element on the page.
rules.action: Fail the build; every navigation target must exist exactly once.

rules.condition: The section id is missing or differs from its data-doc-section key.
rules.action: Fail the build; use the section key as its id.

rules.condition: The page has no section links navigation (data-doc-nav sections).
rules.action: Fail the build; render the shared section links that stay visible at 320px.

rules.condition: A section link or contents link does not point to a documentation section on the page.
rules.action: Fail the build; link only to existing section ids.

rules.condition: One navigation lists the same target more than once.
rules.action: Fail the build; list each target once per navigation.

rules.condition: A documentation section is missing from the section links.
rules.action: Fail the build; list every section in the section links.

rules.condition: A shared component section is absent.
rules.action: Fail the build; render every shared component section.

rules.condition: A shared component section appears more than once.
rules.action: Fail the build; render each shared section once.

rules.condition: Component sections are out of the shared order or include an undeclared section.
rules.action: Fail the build; follow the published component section order.

rules.condition: The live examples section has no rendered demonstration.
rules.action: Fail the build; mount the existing live demonstration in the examples panel.

rules.condition: More than one live demonstration area is mounted.
rules.action: Fail the build; mount the live demonstration exactly once.

rules.condition: The API section has no local API table.
rules.action: Fail the build; document the component API on its own page.

rules.condition: The API section has no official reference link.
rules.action: Fail the build; keep the official Ant Design reference in the API section.

rules.condition: The official reference is not a usable https destination on the official Ant Design domain.
rules.action: Fail the build; link to the official https reference.

rules.condition: The Astro integration section lacks an island example with an import and client directive, or lacks the shared guide link.
rules.action: Fail the build; show the trusted React-island example and link to the shared Astro integration guide.

rules.condition: A resource kind lacks concrete source paths, a required GenUX source is absent, or the capability status is missing.
rules.action: Fail the build; name concrete source locations and state the GenUX capability status separately.

rules.event: The complete build output is inspected.
rules.condition: The getting started guide page was not generated.
rules.action: Fail the build; component pages link to that shared guide.

rules.event: The complete build output is inspected.
rules.condition: The getting started guide has no astro-integration target.
rules.action: Fail the build; add the shared Astro integration section.

rules.event: The complete build output is inspected.
rules.condition: The getting started guide contains more than one astro-integration target.
rules.action: Fail the build; keep exactly one shared Astro integration target.

rules.condition: The page has no named documentation sections.
rules.action: Fail the build; divide the page into named, navigable sections.

rules.event: The documentation standard page is inspected.
rules.condition: A required standard section is absent.
rules.action: Fail the build; publish every standard section.

rules.event: The documentation standard page is inspected.
rules.condition: A declared rule is not published in the rules table.
rules.action: Fail the build; publish every declared rule.

rules.condition: The page lacks exactly one canonical link and exactly one zero-delay refresh, both pointing to its declared canonical target.
rules.action: Fail the build; point the canonical link and the refresh at the declared target.

rules.condition: The page has no link to its declared canonical target.
rules.action: Fail the build; keep a fallback link for clients that do not follow the refresh.

rules.event: The complete build output is inspected.
rules.condition: A declared redirect route or its canonical target was not generated.
rules.action: Fail the build; generate the redirect page and its target, or correct the declared target.

rules.event: A generated HTML page is inspected after the Astro build.
rules.condition: The route has the /preview/<id>/<profile>/ shape but names no literal ExamplePreview id from docs/src/react.
rules.action: Fail the build; prerender previews only for literal ExamplePreview ids.

rules.condition: The page does not hydrate exactly one island, the delivery entry of its route profile.
rules.action: Fail the build; hydrate only the selected profile's delivery entry.

rules.condition: The selected island does not server-render exactly one data-preview-document for the route profile.
rules.action: Fail the build; server-render the preview document; client-only placeholders do not count.

rules.condition: The preview document contains documentation page chrome such as sections, section navigation or page tools.
rules.action: Fail the build; render the example alone, without the documentation shell.

rules.condition: The preview document lacks exactly one data-preview-content with native interactive markup.
rules.action: Fail the build; mark the rendered example cluster with data-preview-content.
